items.title: Musica
relevant_lines: Scopri come candidarti gratuitamente per lavorare come cantante, musicista e altre figure artistiche legate al mondo della musica!
Audizioni Opera e Lirica a Roma: cercasi cantanti lirici e professori d’orchestra — soprani, mezzosoprani, tenori, baritoni, bassi.
Selezioni aperte per artisti del settore musicale e lirico.
items.auto_review_reason: The stable Musica category explicitly covers singers and music professionals and currently lists an opera-singer audition with named voice types. The publisher self-identifies as a general casting portal that accepts externally submitted notices and warns that not all third-party notices are fully reliable; therefore it is approved only as a high-value third-party discovery source, never as an official publisher.
items.review_notes: Discovery-only. Verify each opportunity against the original organizer before publication. The third-party listing reports an application deadline of 2026-11-13 and an audition on 2026-11-17 in Rome. The official Opera e Lirica website separately uses candidatureopera@gmail.com for another vacancy, which corroborates the address but does not verify this audition notice. No first-party notice for this audition was found; do not add it to data/opportunities.json.

lead_crosscheck.evidence_excerpt: The official Opera e Lirica website lists candidatureopera@gmail.com as the application address for a separate Social Media Content Creator vacancy.
lead_crosscheck.finding: This corroborates that the email address is used by Opera e Lirica, but the official page does not publish or verify the specific 17 November 2026 singer audition.

Belli. Publisher identity and vocal relevance are high-confidence. The parent page was successfully fetched by the existing production source refresh on 2026-11-11; robots.txt for this exact child path was not independently retrievable in this audit.
items.review_notes: Source candidate only. The official page says the bando and information will be available soon; no application deadline, eligibility, fee, application route or official PDF is published yet. Do not create or publish an opportunity until the official call and supporting details appear. The separate libere-audizioni-2026 page has a 2026-03-20 deadline and is historical, not a current opportunity.
